title: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. - Romans 12:2
paragraphs: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. - Romans 12:2
Done Bible Study and Cellgroup here at Weegol's Garden

These young men and women are now truly being transformed by GOD for His kingdom. As week and more weeks passed by, i am witnessing big transformation and growth not only on their attitudes but also in character as well. happy to see them grow in Christ Jesus teachings.

Thanks again my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for letting your staff and venue be used for the advancement of GOD's kingdom, your never ending support is astounding and giving us hope towards godliness, may GOD bless you abundantly for your generosity.

and to my bro Mayor Doctor Edward U. Chan , thanks again for your understanding and support, your big heart to help others is a rare virtue to behold, Thanks again, and may GOD continue to pour out blessings on your businesses and endeavors on helping the people and community.
